title: Benchmarking coding agents on the work developers bring to Kiro
text: Developers use Kiro for everything from a quick question to work that spans many files and many rounds of conversation: adding a feature, tracking down a bug in an unfamiliar codebase, or getting a project to build. We needed a way to measure agents across all of these use cases, so that we could build an agent that meets developers’ needs in real workflows.
